comparisons.source: BRIEF.md:3,9: 'Status cells are 16 by 16 logical pixels'; 'Ready and Retry are static images'. src/queue-view.ts:6,9 frames:1, cell:[16,16].
comparisons.delta: Exactly 16x16, one frame preserves both requirements; no horizontal strip or extra canvas follows from these.
comparisons.alternative_disposition: An animated or larger canvas is not source conforming. No added restriction.

comparisons.delta: No opaque matte outside subject operationalizes transparency; partial alpha explicitly permitted.
comparisons.alternative_disposition: A transparent candidate with partially transparent edge pixels remains allowed; no binary alpha rule.

comparisons.source: BRIEF.md:9: 'Ready must visibly use a check mark with asymmetrical arms to convey successful completion.' src/queue.ts:3 ok:succeeded; src/queue-view.ts:3,6 idle Start, succeeded Ready.
comparisons.delta: Literal required check and asymmetry retained, with qualitative success outcome. No arm ratio, stroke width, backing-shape or highlight restriction.
comparisons.alternative_disposition: A thin asymmetrical check, a check with different arm ratios, or a check on a transparent-background decorative shape may pass if it communicates completion. A symmetric check is excluded by the owner, not a specialist invention.

comparisons.source: BRIEF.md:3: 'readable silhouettes'; 'Inspect at 1x and 3x nearest display scale on the actual dark panel'. src/queue-view.ts:9 background:'#172336', scale:3, filter:'nearest'.
comparisons.delta: Uses actual display conditions and asks essential detail to remain readable, without pixel geometry thresholds.
comparisons.alternative_disposition: Different readable silhouettes remain allowed. No unsupported quantitative proxy.

comparisons.source: BRIEF.md:3: 'the existing UI’s cool blue accent; a fixed palette is not required' (apostrophe normalized); assets/start.svg:1 fill='#70b9ed'.
comparisons.delta: Dominant cool-blue visual relationship is the interpretation of using existing accent. No exact hex or color-count rule; Start is a color cue, not approved pixel-art style.
comparisons.alternative_disposition: Other cool blues and multiple tones remain admissible. A mostly unrelated-colored icon with a token blue pixel may fail this reasonable interpretation.

comparisons.source: BRIEF.md:3 'Create coherent pixel-art status assets'; :5 'propose a representative status sample before expanding the family'. Expert basis expressly retained, authority proposal.
comparisons.delta: Clean clusters/edges, no noisy stray pixels/blur/downscaled artifacts and plausible extensibility add expert sample quality requirements.
comparisons.alternative_disposition: An intentionally noisy or blurred but otherwise brief-conforming check could fail. Adopt this narrower expert quality criterion only for this representative candidate; it does not create universal palette, edge-alpha, or construction rules and does not approve style.
